# Orders, billing, and support

Nook Home support policies. These are the rules support agents follow; quote them to customers in plain words.

## Billing

### Duplicate or unexpected charges: authorization and capture

When a payment is authorized and then captured, some banks show both as separate pending lines for 2 to 3 business days before the authorization drops off. The customer is only ever charged once per order.

### Duplicate or unexpected charges: what to ask for

If both charges are still showing after 3 business days, ask the customer for the last four digits of the card and the order number.

### Duplicate or unexpected charges: refunds

A confirmed duplicate charge is refunded within one business day of receiving the last four digits of the card and the order number. Charges the customer does not recognize are checked against the order history first.

## Orders and support

### Shipping times

Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days within the continental US. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days. Orders placed after 2 pm ship the next business day.

### Doorbell video clips

Video clips from the Sentry doorbell are stored in the cloud for 30 days and then deleted automatically. Clips can be downloaded from the app before they expire.

### Battery life

The Sentry doorbell battery lasts up to 6 months on a full charge, depending on how many motion events it records. A low-battery alert appears in the app at 15 percent.

### Cancelling an order

An order can be cancelled for a full refund within 24 hours of purchase, as long as it has not shipped. After that, use the returns process.

### Firmware updates

Firmware updates install automatically overnight and take about 10 minutes. The device restarts once and keeps all of its settings and automations.

### Support hours

Support is available from 8 am to 8 pm Eastern, Monday to Saturday. Messages sent outside those hours are answered the next business day.

### Professional installation

Professional installation appointments for the thermostat and the doorbell take up to 2 hours and can be booked from the Orders page for 3 weeks after delivery.

### Account data

Account data is stored in the United States. Customers can export or delete their data from the account page, and deletion completes within 7 days.
